The renderer shell, cube buffer requests and retained color and depth extents are checked with independent ordinary allocation and Release OpenGL driver observations. A refused cube upload retires its candidates and permits retry. A refused framebuffer resize preserves the previous target. A refused temporary image restores its attachment and retires its name. Shared block and object draws preserve caller bindings, color and depth state, including a bound unpack buffer. Caller-owned unique outputs and atlas sources survive renderer shutdown. The menu and in-game reports see one bound renderer with the same cube storage source. All 46 Release regression groups, seven related tests and scoped native checks pass. Driver overhead and external preview, shader and icon source storage, platform memory and full S0–S6 acceptance remain open.
